data.current_summary: Connect Stripe or GitHub with one key
data.current_description: Registers an app's inbound URL as a webhook at Stripe or GitHub using the provider's own key, saves the signing secret the provider yields, and turns on signature verification at the edge. The provider is read from the key prefix (sk_/rk_ for Stripe, github_pat_/ghp_ for GitHub). The key is used for these calls only and is not stored. Without `app`, a new app is created for the provider (and removed again if the provider refuses the key). Re-running replaces the registration instead of duplicating it. Least privilege: a Stripe restricted key with Webhook Endpoints = Write, or a fine-grained GitHub token with Webhooks = Read and write.
data.description_suggestion: Automatically registers the app's inbound webhook URL with Stripe or GitHub using the provider's API key. Provider is determined from key prefix: sk_/rk_ for Stripe, github_pat_/ghp_ for GitHub. The key is used only for registration and not stored. Saves the provider's signing secret and enables edge-based signature verification. If app_slug is not provided, creates a new app; if provider rejects the key, the app is removed. Re-running this operation replaces any existing registration without duplication. Returns the app configuration with webhook registration status. Requires Stripe restricted key with Webhook Endpoints=Write permission, or GitHub fine-grained token with Webhooks=Read+Write.

data.current_summary: Connect Stripe or GitHub with one key
data.current_description: Registers an app's inbound URL as a webhook at Stripe or GitHub using the provider's own key, saves the signing secret the provider yields, and turns on signature verification at the edge. The provider is read from the key prefix (sk_/rk_ for Stripe, github_pat_/ghp_ for GitHub). The key is used for these calls only and is not stored. Without `app`, a new app is created for the provider (and removed again if the provider refuses the key). Re-running replaces the registration instead of duplicating it. Least privilege: a Stripe restricted key with Webhook Endpoints = Write, or a fine-grained GitHub token with Webhooks = Read and write.
data.summary_suggestion: Auto-register webhook with provider using API key
data.description_suggestion: Automatically registers the app's inbound webhook URL with Stripe or GitHub using the provider's API key. Provider is determined from key prefix (sk_/rk_ for Stripe, github_pat_/ghp_ for GitHub). The operation: (1) registers the webhook at the provider, (2) retrieves and stores the signing secret, (3) enables edge-based signature verification. The provider key is used only for registration and is not persisted. If no app_slug is provided, a new app is created; if the provider rejects the key, the app is cleaned up. Re-running this operation replaces any existing registration without duplication. Requires least-privilege credentials: Stripe restricted key with Webhook Endpoints Write permission, or GitHub fine-grained token with Webhooks Read+Write permission.
